Name: Ring Pop for Content Patcher
Author: Cedarwood7916
Description:
It does exactly what it sounds like. Just download, extract all and slide it into your mods folder.

Big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/43761177]sqbr[/url] for making the actual code part of this. If you want to make your own version, you might want to start from their raw code at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13630?tab=posts]Mermaid's Ring[/url].

It isn't wearable. This is just a texture replacement.
